data.register.sh:
set -e
echo "waiting for temporal..."
i=0; until temporal --address temporal:7233 operator cluster health >/dev/null 2>&1; do i=$((i+1)); [ $i -gt 60 ] && { echo "temporal not ready"; exit 1; }; sleep 3; done
attributes=$(temporal --address temporal:7233 operator search-attribute list --namespace default -o json)
for n in MycelState MycelPhase; do
  if printf '%s\n' "$attributes" | grep -Eq "\"$n\"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*\"INDEXED_VALUE_TYPE_KEYWORD\""; then continue; fi
  temporal --address temporal:7233 operator search-attribute create --namespace default --name "$n" --type Keyword
done
echo "search attributes registered"
